'''Neti''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] used by the treelike [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The language was composed of both verbal and gestural components, and as a result was quite difficult for outsiders to learn.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
